name: King
blurb: Rams enemies, heals from his crown (stronger every time) and summons 4 pawns.

sfx.summon: royal trumpet blip plus magic poof
sfx.ultimate: short royal fanfare call to arms

art.floor: a royal red carpet with gold trim running over polished cream marble floor tiles
art.body: a stern little king: a perfectly round deep red ball body, a golden jeweled crown with red gems on top, a white ermine fur collar with black spots around the bottom, bushy white eyebrows, small determined eyes, rosy cheeks

summons.pawn: a tiny royal pawn soldier: a perfectly round red ball body, a small steel kettle helmet, brave little eyes

art.ultimate_icon: a golden royal trumpet with a small red banner
art.ult_circle: a royal golden circle with a crown emblem in the center and jewel studs around the ring
art.ult_aura: a radiant golden royal aura with sparkling gems and a floating crown glow
art.hit_fx: a burst of golden coins and yellow sparkles
